name: Groves
overview: The Bible reveals that groves, often associated with the worship of the Phoenician goddess Asherah, were forbidden near the altar of the LORD (Deuteronomy 16:21). Despite this, the Israelites frequently served Baalim and the groves, turning away from God (Judges 3:7). Gideon's obedience to God's command to cut down the grove and destroy the altar of Baal (Judges 6:25-28) exemplifies the call to reject idolatry and restore proper worship. These passages underscore the spiritual danger of groves as symbols of false worship and the necessity of their removal for faithful devotion to God.
